items.title: Agensh: multi-agent orchestration with no central scheduler
items.summary: An open-source (MIT) multi-agent framework from Microsoft, released October 24, 2026: instead of a central orchestrator, agents organize the work among themselves.

items.title: Cursor Computer Use: agents operate desktop apps and test their own work
items.summary: Released on October 23, 2026, Cursor's Computer Use lets agents directly operate desktop applications and the iOS simulator — testing the features they just built instead of only writing code.
